[0029] isolates the product of the rearrangement as 红棕色固体, a red-brown solid, and that is the crude residue before any purification, not the material the patent finally isolates. appearance, color and physical_form are left null here so that the isolated product's own description survives the merge: this section sorts second-to-last of the fifteen, so a value in any of those three fields would overwrite the pale yellow solid an example reports for the purified product and leave the merged record describing the crude while quantifying the product. quantity, nmr and melting_point are null because [0029] states no mass, volume, equivalent or yield anywhere.

notes: [0029] charges this acyl chloride into the flask, then adds thionyl chloride to it and strips the excess, which is the operation one performs on the benzoic acid, while [0031] draws the same scheme starting from the free acid. Both compounds are therefore emitted as separate records and the contradiction is recorded, not resolved. commercially_available is false per rule 11 because [0009] describes it being prepared from the benzoic acid, even though [0029] charges it as a starting material; both facts are in the document and point opposite ways. The two EN lines render 甲磺酰基 differently (methylsulfonyl at [0029], methanesulfonyl at [0032]); the Chinese is identical in both places, so this is a translation artefact only and the canonical spelling is used. The in-process control on 原料 (starting material) content is recorded in analytics as this section's only analytical datum; which material 原料 denotes there is subject to the same acid versus acyl chloride contradiction. quantity is null: [0029] gives no quantity.

Drawing-only in this section: no line of prose names it. It is present only as the step 1 reactant of the [0031] IMAGE_EXTRACT scheme, and its drawn SMILES is in aliases per rules 4b and 4f. The drawn scheme starts from this free acid while the [0029] prose charges the acyl chloride; the two are emitted as two records from two different sources and the contradiction is recorded, not resolved. quantity, nmr and melting_point are null: a drawn structure carries no quantity.

The patent never prints a full name for this compound. [0032] prints 烯醇脂, using the character for fat in place of the character for ester; that is the patent's own typo and it is recorded as an alias exactly as printed and deliberately not corrected. The structure is fixed by the step 1 product drawn at [0031] and that drawn SMILES is in aliases per rules 4b and 4f; the prose never spells the structure out, so this is a compound a prose-only reader has no structure for. Intermediate step product of the section, so is_section_product is false. quantity is null; [0029] and [0032] give none.

[0029] adds it slowly to the material it names as the benzoyl chloride, reacts, then distils it off with the solvent as the excess; chlorinating an acyl chloride is the operation one performs on the acid, and [0031] correspondingly carries SOCl2 as the step 1 condition over the free acid. Contradiction recorded, not resolved. SOCl2 is kept as an alias because that is how [0031] prints it. quantity is null: [0029] gives no quantity.

One record for both spellings in this section: [0029] prints 1,3环己二酮, carrying the locant but no hyphen, and [0032] prints 环己二酮 with no locant at all. Merged per rule 4 with both forms in aliases. The 1,3 locant is fixed by the document itself, by [0029] and by the 1,3-dione drawn at [0031], not by outside knowledge. [0031] carries it as a condition entry that states it is drawn as a structure and not as a written label, so the drawing is a second, independent source for it. quantity is null: [0029] gives no quantity.

role catalyst follows this run's shared identifier table, which takes it from [0011], which prints it as 催化剂丙酮氰醇 (catalyst acetone cyanohydrin). This section on its own would have said reagent: [0029] charges it into the flask together with the 1,3-cyclohexanedione with no catalytic language, and [0031] carries it only as the step 2 condition. The disagreement is recorded here rather than being decided silently by the section merge. quantity is null: [0029] gives no quantity.
